title: Run-wait prompt wording: provisional follow-ups, retried reads, and the "not sent" parenthetical
outcome: Run-wait resume prompts describe what is still undecided, and the outcomes that will resume the wait, accurately.
acceptance: The follow-up's line for undecided provisional runs names every outcome that resumes the wait again (a built record, or a record the host leaves pending for good), and never promises a resume that may not come; the line for marked runs does not call a record 'being sent' while the host is only retrying a read of the run's files; and the 'not sent' text for a run whose readable results never carried a committed-input record does not say its directory was removed or its files rewritten. Covered by behaviour tests.
